provenance.caveat: No way for the harness to start a Cursor subagent has been verified.
No way for the harness to read a running subagent's state has been verified.
No way for the harness to send a message to a running subagent has been verified.
No way for the harness to stop a running subagent has been verified.
No subagent event stream has been verified.

notes: Cursor hook payloads give the adapter no session id (`cursor_adapter.cursor_session_id`), so a handle could not yet be tied to the conversation that asked for it.
